senses.definition: A coursebook, a formal manual of instruction in a specific subject, especially one for use in schools or colleges.
Of or pertaining to textbooks or their style, especially in being dry and pedagogical; textbooky, textbooklike.
senses.example: These figures are just too textbook, or papyrus-like, as if this information came off of a shelf in the Library of Alexandria

senses.definition: Having the typical characteristics of some class of phenomenon, so that it might be included as an example in a textbook.
Done exactly correctly, in an exemplary way that might be described in a textbook.
senses.example: Well done everyone, the tree fell exactly where we planned. That was textbook.

senses.definition: Learned from, or as if learned from, a textbook, as opposed to personal discovery or experience.
senses.example: He has a textbook understanding of company law but no practical experience of litigation.
